courses.title: Getting Started with ShapeLMS (Demo)
courses.excerpt: A short demo course that shows lessons, videos, attachments and a quiz. Edit or delete it at any time.
courses.content:
This demo course walks you through how ShapeLMS works from a student's point of view. Open it, enroll, complete a lesson and take the quiz.

Everything you see here was built with the course builder. Open the builder to see how topics, lessons and questions fit together.

requirements: A WordPress site with ShapeLMS installed
outcomes: Understand how courses, topics and lessons are organised
Know what students see on the learning page
Take a quiz and see instant results
audience: Site owners trying ShapeLMS for the first time

items.title: How this course works
items.content:
Courses are made of topics, and each topic holds lessons and quizzes. The sidebar on the left shows the full curriculum and your progress.

When you finish reading a lesson, click Mark as complete at the bottom. Your progress bar at the top updates immediately.

items.title: Watching a video lesson
items.content: Lessons can embed a YouTube or Vimeo video, play a self-hosted file, or use an embed code from another provider. The video sits above the text so students can watch and read.

topics.title: Check your understanding
topics.summary: A short quiz with every question type.

items.title: Demo quiz
items.content: Five questions, one of each type. You need 60% to pass and you can retake it as often as you like.

questions.title: What is a course made of?

options.text: Topics that contain lessons and quizzes

questions.explanation: Courses are organised as topics, and each topic holds lessons and quizzes.

questions.title: Which of these can a lesson contain? (select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Lessons hold video, attachments and rich text. Courses cannot be nested.

questions.title: Progress is tracked automatically when you mark a lesson complete.
questions.explanation: Yes. Completing lessons and passing quizzes updates your course progress.

questions.title: What button do you click at the bottom of a lesson when you finish it?
questions.explanation: The button is labelled "Mark as complete".

items.title: What's next
items.content: You have seen the whole student journey. Now open ShapeLMS → Courses in the admin, edit this course in the builder, and make it your own, or create a brand-new course.
